app_context: Indonesian Retail POS (Point of Sale) & Store Management Web Application (React JS + FastAPI + MongoDB)

currency_formatting.rule: Always format money with Indonesian thousand separator (dot: '.') without decimals for whole rupiah amounts (e.g. Intl.NumberFormat('id-ID', { style: 'currency', currency: 'IDR', minimumFractionDigits: 0 }).format(val) or custom clean format `Rp${Number(val).toLocaleString('id-ID')}`)

font_hierarchy.pos_grand_total: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-black font-mono tracking-tight text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400
font_hierarchy.pos_change_due: text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold font-mono text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300
font_hierarchy.h1_page_title: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100
font_hierarchy.h2_section_title: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100
font_hierarchy.label_overline: text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400
font_hierarchy.table_header: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/80

typography.guidelines: Avoid default Inter/Roboto for titles. Use Plus Jakarta Sans (widely beloved modern standard in Indonesian tech ecosystems) combined with crisp JetBrains Mono for monetary totals, quantities, and barcode inputs.

colors.theme_archetype: Retail Precision & High-Trust Commerce (Archetype 4 + Archetype 1 hybrid: Deep Navy Slate, Forest Emerald, warm Amber accent)

primary.meaning: Emerald Green for successful commerce, Rupiah transactions, checkout button

colors.rules: Never use pure #000000; neutrals are tinted with cool slate. Header and dropdowns must NOT have 100% transparent backgrounds. Keep checkout total screen high contrast (white on dark slate or emerald on cream/white).

layout_and_navigation.structure: Sidebar + Sticky Top Bar + Fluid Main Workspace (Split Screen on Kasir)

elements: Store Name & Current Shift Indicator ('Toko Serba Ada')
Live Date & Time in Indonesian (e.g. 'Senin, 13 Juli 2026 • 14:35 WIB')
Device Status Indicators (Barcode Scanner: Siap, Printer: 58mm/80mm Siap, Database: Tersambung)

kasir_layout_split.desktop_ratio: Left 60% (Product Search & Catalog Grid) | Right 40% (Interactive Cart & Payment Drawer)

left_catalog.header: Barcode Input with Auto-Focus + Search by Name/SKU + Category Pills filter
left_catalog.grid: High density cards with Stock badge (green > 10, amber <= 5, red 0), Price in IDR, Category tag, Add-to-cart on click

right_cart.cart_table: Item list with Qty (+/- / numeric input), per-item discount, subtotal, and delete button
right_cart.summary_section: Subtotal, Global Discount input (Rp / %), Tax Toggle (PPN 11%), Grand Total (Very prominent)
right_cart.payment_panel: Nominal Tunai buttons (Uang Pas, 10rb, 20rb, 50rb, 100rb, 200rb), Kembalian (Change) highlight, Bayar & Cetak Struk (F9/Enter) button

keyboard_shortcuts.ui_display: Floating bottom or top keyboard shortcut helper ribbon visible in Kasir page

methods.description: CSS @media print optimized for 58mm (default thermal) and 80mm thermal roll paper.
methods.css_classes: print:w-[58mm] print:m-0 print:p-2 font-mono text-[12px] leading-tight text-black

methods.description: Raw ESC/POS command generator with options to Download .bin file or Copy raw print text for Windows Spooler / ESC/POS thermal printer daemon.

receipt_content_structure: Date, Time, Cashier Name, Receipt No: TRX-YYYYMMDD-XXXX
Items List: [Item Name] [Qty x Unit Price] [Subtotal]
Subtotal, Diskon, Pajak (PPN 11% jika aktif), Total
Footer Message: 'Terima Kasih Atas Kunjungan Anda! Barang yang sudah dibeli tidak dapat ditukar.'

hero_and_store_banners.description: Indonesian retail checkout counter atmosphere with cashier scanning groceries
Retail shop shelves showing organized stock and goods display
Neat shelf with snacks, beverages and packaged items for retail store overview

testing_attributes.rule: Every button, input, tab, filter, modal trigger, print button, and key summary metric MUST contain data-testid in kebab-case format.

component_guidelines.buttons: Pill or sleek rounded-md (rounded-lg). Primary action is rich emerald (bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white font-medium shadow-sm transition-colors active:scale-[0.98]). Danger actions use rose/red.
component_guidelines.cards: Subtle border (border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800), smooth surface (bg-white dark:bg-slate-900), rounded-xl p-5 shadow-[0_1px_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)]. Avoid heavy drop shadows.
component_guidelines.tables: Sticky table header, compact line height for high retail density, zebra alternating subtle tint on hover, clear currency right-aligned columns.
component_guidelines.modals: Dialog backdrop with blur (backdrop-blur-sm bg-slate-950/40), clean white/dark-slate container with accessible close button.
component_guidelines.badges: Pill badges for stock levels: Stock > 10 (emerald-100 text-emerald-800), Stock 1-10 (amber-100 text-amber-800), Out of Stock (rose-100 text-rose-800).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: DO NOT use generic centered templates, generic purple gradient cards, or placeholder URLs like via.placeholder.com. Use genuine Indonesian retail context (e.g. Indomie, Bimoli, Beras, Aqua, etc.).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.state_persistency: Ensure all store data (Products, Categories, Purchases, Transactions, Settings) are synchronized with FastAPI backend and locally cached / fallback gracefully so the cashier never loses cart state even if network flickers.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.speed_optimization: Kasir (POS) screen must register item scans in under 100ms. Provide hotkeys [F2, F4, F8, F9, Enter] and maintain barcode input auto-focus when scanning.
